findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_account_status, get_company_profile, get_matching_status, get_pipeline, get_insights, get_change_status, list_company_profiles, get_company_brief, get_company_matches, get_company_pipeline, get_tender_decision · Private data: get_company_pipeline, review_company_match · Public sink: list_company_profiles, get_company_brief, get_company_matches, get_company_pipeline, update_company_matching_profile, update_company_profile · Destructive: search_tenders.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_account_status, get_company_profile, get_matching_status, get_pipeline, get_insights, get_change_status, list_company_profiles, get_company_brief, get_company_matches, get_company_pipeline, get_tender_decision · Private data: get_company_pipeline, review_company_match · Public sink: list_company_profiles, get_company_brief, get_company_matches, get_company_pipeline, update_company_matching_profile, update_company_profile · Destructive: search_tenders

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
